facts.business: Jindal Steel Limited is an integrated steel manufacturer with crude steelmaking capacity of 15.6 MTPA across its Angul and Raigarh plants in India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Angul Integrated Steel Plant Phase II completion

auditor.name: Lodha & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on outstanding loan to wholly owned subsidiary Jindal Steel (Mauritius) Limited amounting to Rs 4,586.80 crore (including interest), where subsidiary auditors included inherent uncertainty paragraph relating to going concern matter without modifying their opinion; accumulated losses and negative net worth of subsidiary are Rs 6,966.40 crore and Rs 5,379.27 crore respectively.

key_risks: Claims and exposures relating to taxation and litigation
Geopolitical uncertainty, volatile commodity markets and evolving global trade dynamics
